decision_source: Author rejected the pilot-based launch recommendation and requested Kayros proof-speed improvement before resuming the main experiment.
resume_conditions: Identify and close Kayros's measured proof-speed gap against the fixed original Lera-Romero baseline.
Demonstrate improvement under a comparison design fixed before confirmation, preserving unfavorable outcomes and the anytime comparison.
Review the resulting evidence and updated main design with the author before launch.
note: This is a decision record, not an execution lock. The existing distributed driver does not read this file.
